description: The capabilities the main window is granted, and nothing more. Every entry is here because a feature needs it. The window may be dragged, minimised, maximised, closed and themed. The dialog plugin may only open and save: it returns a path a person chose — the folder a work lives in — and only the host's own commands read or write there, inside that folder. There is no filesystem plugin, so nothing can walk a directory; no shell plugin, so nothing can run a program; and no HTTP plugin, so nothing can reach the network.
